429143.mnemonic: 准备不足（scarce）的我吓得（scared）“几乎”（scarcely）说不出话。

sentence.en: His grandfather can scarcely hear his grandson speaking.
sentence.cn: 他祖父几乎听不到他孙子说的话。

meanEn.text: to become aware of somebody or something by using your eyes(the past tense of see)

429053.mnemonic: "saw"最常见的含义是“锯”，比如："She sawed the branch off the tree." (她把树枝锯了下来)。你还可以说"saw through"（锯透），"saw up"（锯成小块）。它也"see"的过去式形式。此外，你还可以说 "saw the light"（开窍）， "saw action"（参战）哟～🪚

sentence.en: She saw a shooting star fly across the sky.
sentence.cn: 她看见一颗流星划过天际。

derivations.mean: vt. 用竖锯锯，使互相交错搭接
